note: Reviewed exhaustive economic-deployment plans and narrowly scoped exhaustive provider-chain accounting reviews. No static supply numbers or incomplete claimed scopes; per-asset authoring follows verified current circulation, escrow and in-flight research.

providerChainPartitionReviews.rationale: Circle's August 6 launch identifies b6ce...3061 as native USDC and 74b7...6d22 as separate Ethereum-bridged USDC not issued by Circle. The pinned DefiLlama XLayer config lists exactly these two contracts: issued native USDC and bridgedFromETH USDC.e. Its adapter reads native totalSupply via chainMinted with six decimals and bridged totalSupply via bridgedSupply with six decimals, with no XLayer unreleased deductions. The chain row is their disjoint same-USDC-unit sum; a common USD valuation cancels in the relative allocation. Read both total supplies and decimals at one authenticated numbered block, preserve the admitted provider row and all other chain rows, and retain the bridged route's own controller/risk. This review certifies only XLayer attribution, not a global USDC liability census or Ethereum escrow/pending accounting.

providerRowExclusionReviews.rationale: FIP419 upgrades the Fraxtal stablecoin predeploy in place to frxUSD; FIP430 separates frxUSD and Legacy FRAX liabilities. At block 42061479 the provider's fc...01 contract reports Frax USD / frxUSD and REMOTE_TOKEN Ethereum frxUSD. Exclude only this mislabelled provider row from unresolved-deployment and unmatched/unreviewed bridge-share numerators, retaining the original aggregate, chain observations and all other materiality facts. Nonzero LFRAX at ff...1fd remains a separate legacy deployment/catalog question and is not excluded.

nativeSingleRouteReviews.rationale: xDAI is Gnosis Chain's native gas token: 100% of the published aggregate supply is native xDAI on Gnosis, minted and burned solely through the canonical xDAI bridge that the single reviewed route represents. The route's WXDAI deployment row (gnosis:0xe91d153e0b41518a2ce8dd3d7944fa863463a97d) is a same-chain wrapper and strict subset of the native supply, so no per-chain contract observation can equal the aggregate upstream. Attributing the published aggregate to this one reviewed route restates the reviewed bridge profile without asserting any new supply number.
